source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves all three women, purchase, spices, purpose, and Jesus as the intended body.
key_decisions.before: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so they could go and anoint Jesus.
key_decisions.after: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so they could go and anoint Jesus.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And when the Sabbath had passed, Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James and Salome bought spices, so that they might go and anoint him.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps both time markers and arrival at the tomb.
key_decisions.before: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they went to the tomb.
key_decisions.after: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they came to the tomb.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And very early on the first day of the week, when the sun had risen, they came to the tomb.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps their changed line of sight, the stone’s completed removal, and explanatory size.
key_decisions.before: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone—which was very large—had been rolled away.
key_decisions.after: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone had been rolled away, even though it was extremely large.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And looking up, they saw that the stone had been rolled away, for it was very large.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains young man rather than harmonized angel, his position and clothing, and the women’s reaction.
key_decisions.before: Entering the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe, and they were alarmed.
key_decisions.after: They entered the tomb and saw a young man sitting on the right, dressed in a white robe, and they were alarmed.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a white robe, and they were alarmed.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the search target, crucifixion, passive resurrection announcement, absence, and invitation to see.
key_decisions.before: He said to them, “Do not be alarmed. You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has been raised; he is not here. Look at the place where they laid him.
key_decisions.after: He said to them, “Do not be alarmed. You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has been raised; he is not here. Look at the place where they laid him.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But he said to them, “Do not be alarmed. You seek Jesus the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has been raised; he is not here. See the place where they laid him.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Peter’s separate naming, Jesus’ advance, promised sight, and link to his earlier words.
key_decisions.before: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He is going ahead of you into Galilee. You will see him there, just as he told you.’”
key_decisions.after: But go, tell his disciples and Peter: ‘He is going ahead of you into Galilee. You will see him there, just as he told you.’”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But go, tell his disciples and Peter that he is going before you into Galilee. There you will see him, just as he told you.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the main-text ending’s flight, bodily fear, astonishment, silence, and final because without appending an appearance account.
key_decisions.before: They went out and fled from the tomb because trembling and astonishment had seized them. They said nothing to anyone, because they were afraid.
key_decisions.after: They went out and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had seized them. They said nothing to anyone, because they were afraid.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And going out, they fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had seized them. And they said nothing to anyone, for they were afraid.

key_decisions.rationale: The separate heading marks this as part of the bracketed longer ending; the verse preserves time, first appearance, Mary, and seven demons.
key_decisions.before: After Jesus rose early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
key_decisions.after: After Jesus rose early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had driven out seven demons.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now after he rose early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps different form, exactly two, their walking, and rural destination.
key_decisions.before: After this he appeared in another form to two of them while they were walking on their way into the countryside.
key_decisions.after: After this, he appeared in a different form to two of them as they walked on their way into the countryside.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And after these things he appeared in another form to two of them as they were walking, going into the country.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the Eleven, meal posture, both faults, the reason for rebuke, eyewitnesses, and passive resurrection.
key_decisions.before: Later Jesus appeared to the eleven while they were reclining at the table. He rebuked their unbelief and hardness of heart because they had not believed those who saw him after he had been raised.
key_decisions.after: Later he appeared to the Eleven as they reclined at the table. He rebuked their unbelief and hardness of heart because they had not believed those who saw him after he was raised.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Afterward he appeared to the eleven themselves as they were reclining at table, and he rebuked their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they had not believed those who saw him after he had been raised.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps belief and baptism together in the first clause and unbelief alone as the stated ground in the second.
key_decisions.before: Whoever trusts and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not trust will be condemned.
key_decisions.after: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The one who believes and is baptized will be saved, but the one who does not believe will be condemned.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains signs, believers, Jesus’ name, exorcism, and new languages without turning them into commands.
key_decisions.before: These signs will accompany those who trust: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak in new tongues;
key_decisions.after: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues;
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And these signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak in new tongues;

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves snakes, conditional poison, emphatic protection, laying on hands, and healing without encouraging deliberate tests.
key_decisions.before: they will pick up snakes, and if they drink anything deadly, it will certainly not harm them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will become well.”
key_decisions.after: they will pick up snakes, and if they drink anything deadly, it will certainly not harm them; they will lay hands on the sick, and the sick will become well.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: they will pick up serpents with their hands, and if they drink anything deadly, it will certainly not harm them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will be well.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the full title, passive ascension, heaven, and enthronement.
key_decisions.before: Then the Lord Jesus, after speaking to them, was taken up into heaven and sat at the right hand of God.
key_decisions.after: After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, he was taken up into heaven and sat at God’s right hand.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: So then the Lord Jesus, after speaking to them, was taken up into heaven and sat at the right hand of God.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps mission, the Lord’s cooperation, word, and confirming signs; the separate heading and note mark this as the close of the longer textual tradition.
key_decisions.before: They went out and proclaimed everywhere, while the Lord worked with them and confirmed the word through the signs that accompanied it.
key_decisions.after: They went out and proclaimed everywhere, while the Lord worked with them and confirmed the word through the signs that accompanied it.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And they went out and proclaimed everywhere, while the Lord worked with them and confirmed the word through the signs that followed.
